title: APC Flags Off Tinubu's 2027 Re-Election Campaign in Kaduna
detail: The APC formally launched President Tinubu's re-election campaign at Kaduna Township Stadium on Oct 24, ahead of the January 16, 2027 presidential election. Tinubu promised to sustain economic recovery and criticised opposition rivals; Governor Uba Sani called it a historic show of party unity. Rallies follow in the South-South, South-East, South-West, North-Central and North-East.

media.caption: APC presidential campaign flag-off in Kaduna
